create_scene_viz: create a SceneViz instance to build a 3D Plotly figure for visualizing camera poses and point clouds
add_pointcloud: add a 3D point cloud with colors and optional mask to the SceneViz figure using add_pointcloud
add_camera: add a single camera frustum with optional image texture to the SceneViz figure using add_camera
add_cameras: add multiple camera frustums with poses, focals, and images to the SceneViz figure using add_cameras
export_html: export the SceneViz figure to a standalone HTML file using export_html with a custom filename
